sermon.title: The Message of Jesus — April 10, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Jesus’ first message was repent. He taught simply, cast out demons without theatrics, touched the leper with compassion and never advertised. What is missing in the American church is the power of God; Paul preached in demonstration of the Spirit and of power.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Message begins at 26:00 after worship.

chunks.short_answer: He never advertised; the power of God and word of mouth drew the crowds.
chunks.text:
What happened to the world and so it made. Jesus’s life very dangerous from those who wanted to kill him so he went out into the desert remote areas. No cities no towns and they came to him in the desert places from every direction. Hallelujah. He went to them and they came to him and church when we can. Seek God and get God moving. Yes we go out and we go to them but when they begin to see God moving they will come to him also hallelujah. Remember Jesus didn’t advertise and he didn’t sell trinklets. Am I right in fact he corrected the people twice who was in the church of God selling trinkets merchandise in the house of God.

Jesus never advertised. His the power of God in him was the advertisement and there’s nothing like word of mouth when somebody gets healed they’re better than the newspaper. If you are filled with the Holy Ghost it should not be by faith it should be an experience that could be seen by others in the change of your life could that be an amen yeah if you are really born again and saved it should be seen.

chunks.short_answer: Faith seen in action—Jesus saw their faith and forgave his sins, then he rose and went home.
chunks.text:
By how you speak now and how you live now faith should be seen not just faith in your faith faith that I have something I don’t have. Faith should be seen and when you possess something the Bible says you don’t need any more faith for it or hope for it you have it. Why why are you still asking. He said to the paralytic. Now this just. This just explodes as a young Christian read in my Bible this just exploded to me. He said to this crippled man son your sins are forgiven this God didn’t ask for forgiveness. scriptures.text_nkjv: Then they came to Him, bringing a paralytic who was carried by four men. And when they could not come near Him because of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where He was. So when they had broken through, they let down the bed on which the paralytic was lying. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.” And some of the scribes were sitting there and reasoning in their hearts, “Why does this Man speak blasphemies like this? Who can forgive sins but God alone?” But immediately, when Jesus perceived in His spirit that they reasoned thus within themselves, He said to them, “Why do you reason about these things in your hearts? Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise, take up your bed and walk’? But that you may know that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins”—He said to the paralytic, “I say to you, arise, take up your bed, and go to your house.” Immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went out in the presence of them all, so that all were amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

chunks.section_question: What is missing in the American church?
chunks.short_answer: The power of God—not a school, children’s program or dynamic worship; he recalls healings and deliverance he has seen.
chunks.text:
I want the freshness of God in my life and in this church is that a good amen yes. Now. I want to repeat this is what’s missing in the American church. Including this one. Including this pastor. You know. One of my mistakes was getting so involved and trying to build a new building. And. Prepare young leaders. That I got away. From seeking God and staying in tune. Hallelujah. And we’re where we’re at today. And that wasn’t bad things it just.

I got distracted. It is the power of God that makes the difference it’s not a Christian school. It’s not a children’s church program it’s not a worship service that’s dynamite it’s the power of God active. In the church and he doesn’t have to wait for an altar call to touch people he can touch them right where they are. And I’ve seen this in my life. I’ve seen it at the vine when it was a coffee house and we were ministering to the drug cultured people. And. Over one handful. Was healed just during the service.

From drugs. Especially one. Pair that came in they were twins. And they come into my office I was in my office preparing the fine details for the service and they came in and I didn’t know beans back then about drugs I never took drugs I stayed away from them I saw my acquaintances destroy their lives so me and drugs we had nothing to do with each other from go from step year one period when they brought it up. But these two guys were obviously high the way they talked the way they acted. But when the service started and we worshiped and back in those days. God so favored that group that he would just come with a powerful presence powerful presence. And in that worship service these twins.

Got healed just like that and the people around them knew. The ones that knew them and they knew God has done something here and they told me after the service those two guys were high. And bam and then they came to the altar and you know they gave their life to Christ and I never seen him again. But I never seen a lot of people again after God met with them. But the key is to allow God to meet with them amen what they do with it is their decision. When I was in el salvador I’ve told you this before. I was brought out into the jungles to minister at a similar God church. And I did not know that they had a big split and the church was down to just a handful and God gave me this message because I seek God for a message for that church everywhere I go and he gave me this message that was so revolutionary to me myself.

And I knew the assembly of God didn’t believe in this so I went to the pastor and I said this is what I want to teach and they always brought me in for three services. Okay and I would teach for three services. Well I taught he gave me permission and you should when you know there’s going to be a conflict you should discuss it with the church leaders you don’t want to embarrass them and embarrass yourself. Anyway I taught this message that geez. Just so powerful is unbelievable. Never seen it before. And God. Began. To move in that message. And they had a speaker outside the church where it was. Messages broadcast the next service the church was full the third service the church was full and there was a multitude outside the church that couldn’t get in.

God restored that church but this is the point I’m preaching in that last service. And the presence of God came so thick. That I had to step away from the pulpit. And my interpreter John farrow. I looked at him and I said John have you ever experienced anything like this I mean it was almost like Jesus was going to appear. And when he comes you don’t want to be in the front you don’t want to be doing anything you just step back and let him do what he wants to do could that be an amen. And John said I’ve never seen anything like that I’ve never experienced anything like this and so we waited there for several minutes and it started dissipating but during this time.

This crowd that had children with them there was no nursery no children’s church or anything these it was like for a period of time everything was frozen. Nobody was moving nobody was making any noise nobody was talking outside the church or inside the church they all recognize the powers presence that come to work on them. And do a work inside of them hallelujah. Then after it dissipated I stepped back finished the message and then I found out after the service what had happened. Okay that they had a big split and all this and God healed and brought everything back and more to boot not just the old members.

chunks.text:
New ones came in amen. Instantly God can do things. Not just heal the sick so in closing. In first Corinthians 2:4. As the worship team comes to. The communion service part of this service. Paul said it very clearly now listen to me church listen to me those online Paul said it very clearly. We want to talk about Paul’s grace and faith and we’re not under law and all that but that Paul said this my speech. My preaching my doctrine my teaching was not with enticing words of man’s wisdom.

Did you catch that. But my speech and my preaching. Was in the spirit. And of power. Wow. And demonstration. Of the spirit. And power. Say that with me in demonstration. Of the spirit and power we can’t heal we can’t save and we can’t really teach unless he’s given us something to say and he anoints what we speak. But what we need is what Paul said here demonstration of the spirit not just believing. What someone said but experiencing. What the word says by the spirit of God and that power could that be an amen.

And I challenge this church and I challenge those online just like I do those on facebook. We need to get away from just teaching and song services that are doing nothing. In most of these churches they just sing and that’s it what’s next. Not looking for prophecy not looking for. Prayers of the spirit or anything just okay and then some churches they bring in a big ban and lights and stages that go up and down and all this stuff. And those churches we find corruption it was just out again this week big churches nationwide. Corruption horrible corruption. See you can’t you can get a crowd by doing certain things but you cannot get disciples.

Unless you have the power of the spirit and the power of the word and the power of the name of Jesus could that be an amen. Hallelujah. He also said. The kingdom of God is not in word not in speech it’s not in talk. But the kingdom of God is in power. Supernatural ability God can come supernaturally fill you with the Holy Ghost heal your body forgive your sins but we need to seek him like Jesus said seek me follow me come to me and this is all the church can do is I’ll give you an invitation to come to Jesus with whatever you need and then it’s Jesus responsibility.

To touch you amen. Now I’ve seen healings. Even in our church maybe one or two a year on a average I remember a guy came in that had a tumor. In his head a brain tumor. And they were going to operate on him and he was scared of dying so he came to church. And he came for several months. And. The church prayed for him the church prayed for him not the elders not the pastor. We all prayed for him. Anyway his day came when he was going to be operated on and he had to go in and be scanned to see if the tumor had moved or anything so they could follow through on the operation.

Well when a scan came back the can the tumor was gone. Absolutely gone. Now he was excited for a couple of weeks. But then he went right back into sin. And my point is this. God heals. As he chooses to heal we had people in the congregation that I thought deserved to be healed and I told him that these are good people what what’s what’s with this this guy comes in by my way and then he goes well what’s the deal here. Yeah. And that’s basically how I talk with God you know what’s going on. But see he’s God he chooses what he does and when he does it could that be an amen he knows everybody’s heart and he does what he wants to do when he wants to do it and we’re just to follow him and allow him the chance to do it could that be an amen.

Hallelujah I wasn’t even there once in a Bible study I was on vacation and this woman pops her head in on the Bible study I was told after I came back and said do you guys believe in healing and the leader of the Bible said of course we do he said pray that I can get pregnant they tell me I can’t get pregnant it’s impossible for me to get pregnant I want to have a child now would you guys pray so they prayed for her well some weeks later she pops back in her head through the door I’m pregnant. Not in a bunch of talk but in power and if you are willing to be a participant of that will you.
